idle.baumannSectionDesc: The Baumann Skin Type Indicator (BSTI), developed by dermatologist Dr. Leslie Baumann, classifies skin along 4 axes: Oily/Dry (O/D), Sensitive/Resistant (S/R), Pigmented/Non-pigmented (P/N), and Wrinkle-prone/Tight (W/T). The combination of each axis defines one of 16 distinct skin types. The era of simply calling skin "dry" or "oily" is over.
idle.howTitle: How does AI skin analysis work?
howSteps: Analyzes skin tone, pores, radiance & spots in your selfie using multi-spectrum analysis
AI quantifies 10 skin indicators on a 0–100 scale
Determines your personal skin type based on Baumann's 4-axis scores
Delivers personalized ingredient, routine & product recommendations for your Baumann type

polluted.title: High Pollution — Double Cleanse
polluted.body: Fine particles clog pores. Use an oil cleanser first, then a foam cleanser, and follow with an antioxidant serum.

snowy.title: Winter Skin Intensive Care
snowy.body: Snow reflects UV rays strongly. Strengthen your skin barrier with ceramide cream and don't skip sunscreen.

rainy.title: Rainy Day Light Moisture
rainy.body: High humidity can increase sebum. Swap heavy creams for a light gel moisturizer to keep skin balanced.

foggy.title: Foggy Day — Cleanse Well
foggy.body: Atmospheric particles can irritate pores. Do a thorough but gentle cleanse when you get home.

cold.title: Cold Wind — Protect Your Barrier
cold.body: Cold air strips moisture fast. Apply a ceramide-rich cream before heading out to shield your skin barrier.

sunny_hot.title: Intense UV — Reapply Sunscreen!
sunny_hot.body: Reapply SPF 50+ every 2 hours. Add a vitamin C serum in the morning for extra antioxidant defense.

sunny.title: Don't Skip Sunscreen
sunny.body: Clear days mean UVA/UVB exposure. Layer vitamin C serum under sunscreen for dual protection.

dry.title: Low Humidity — Layer Moisture
dry.body: Air is dry! Layer essence → serum → cream to lock in hydration throughout the day.

humid.title: High Humidity — Go Light
humid.body: Skip heavy creams and opt for a gel moisturizer or hydrating mist to keep skin comfortable.

cloudy.title: Cloudy Still Means UV
cloudy.body: Clouds let through up to 80% of UV rays. Sunscreen is still essential on overcast days.

O.name: Oily
O.desc: Active sebum production makes skin prone to shine and greasiness.

D.name: Dry
D.desc: Low sebum production leads to tightness and dry patches.

S.name: Sensitive
S.desc: Skin is prone to redness and breakouts from external irritants.

R.name: Resistant
R.desc: Skin barrier is strong and resists external irritants well.

P.name: Pigmented
P.desc: Prone to hyperpigmentation such as dark spots and melasma.

N.name: Non-pigmented
N.desc: Low tendency for hyperpigmentation; even skin tone.

W.name: Wrinkle-prone
W.desc: Reduced elasticity makes skin prone to fine lines.

T.name: Tight
T.desc: Good skin elasticity with fewer visible wrinkles.
